results.title: AI Must Not Determine Who Goes To Jail —SAN
results.description: The Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN)Muyiwa Tola Atoyebi has warned against allowing artificial intelligence to determine decisions affecting people’s freedom, insisting that human judgment, accountability and respect for fundamental rights must remain central to the administration of justice. He said the growing use of data and AI in the justice system must be guided by […]
